title: ADS-Bench v2.0: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark for Neuro-Symbolic LLM Control of Physical Vapor Deposition Systems
description: ADS-Bench v2.0 evaluates language-model agents across 46 tasks (40 short tasks across five cognitive and safety tiers plus 6 live deposition and recipe-audit capstones) on three open physical vapor deposition (PVD) architectures in APS Control Community v1.7.1: single-chamber batch sputtering (Sputter), load-locked multi-source sputtering (ADS), and multi-chamber radial cluster sputtering (Cluster).
